description: UK Power Networks Licence Area Statutory Rivers is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction Shapefile showing the rivers within UK Power Networks' three licence areas. Methodological Approach Data Extraction and Cleaning: Data is downloaded from DEFRA data portal. Data Filtering and Assignment: Only rivers within the UK Power Networks service area are included. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Supporting Information. The portal shows 2026-06-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence v3.0 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
